item.title: Nepali Poem: वनको डडेलो
item.description: With this poem, I warn humanity against ruthless development projects that disrupt the livelihoods of the people who have been sustaining really well in symbiosis with the nature.

item.title: Nepali Poem: उडान
item.description: With this poem, I inspire dreamers to initiate free and informed pursuits of self-growth.
